title: Alien on Rocky Peak
description: A large white spherical alien creature with red spots, a single huge black eye, and multiple pink tentacles stands on an orange and green rocky peak. Several small white eyeballs on thin stalks extend from its head while other detached eyeballs float nearby against a swirling red background.
prompt: A large white spherical alien with red polka dots and one giant black eye stands on an orange and green rocky peak covered in moss and stones. The creature has multiple thick pink tentacles for legs and several small white eyeballs on thin stalks protruding from its head with more eyeballs floating in the air. The background is a swirling vortex of bright red with brush stroke patterns.
